description: The draft must use the supplied organisation facts rather than writing generically. Grounded in REAL KashiGRC IAM controls and their ISO 27001:2022 / SOC 2 citations. This is the case that catches a broken PolicyContextAssembler — the most likely silent regression in the module.

variables.title: Access Control Policy
variables.orgContext:
ORGANISATION CONTEXT
- Legal name: Northwind Data Systems Private Limited
- Referred to in body text as: Northwind
- Industry: B2B SaaS
- Approximate headcount: 140
- Headquarters: India
- Frameworks in scope: SOC2, ISO27001, DPDP

TECHNICAL ESTATE (reference these specifically instead of writing generically)
- Cloud providers: AWS
- Identity provider: Okta
- Device management: Jamf

ACCOUNTABLE ROLES (name these where the policy assigns responsibility)
- Security owner: Meera Raghavan (Head of Security)

DRAFTING CONVENTIONS
- Tone: FORMAL
- Spelling: BRITISH

STATEMENTS THAT MUST NOT APPEAR
The following are factually untrue of this organisation. Never assert them:
Northwind does not process cardholder data. Northwind operates no on-premise infrastructure.

ACCURACY RULE
Use only the facts above. Where a required detail is absent, insert a clearly marked placeholder such as [[RETENTION PERIOD]] rather than inventing a value.
variables.controlRequirements:
CONTROL REQUIREMENTS
This policy must satisfy the following controls. Address every one.

[IAM-01.1] Joiner provisioning and approval
  Framework citations: SOC2 CC6.2, ISO27001 A.5.18
  Domain: IAM

[IAM-01.2] Mover / role-change access update
  Framework citations: SOC2 CC6.3, ISO27001 A.5.18
  Domain: IAM

[IAM-01.3] Leaver deprovisioning within SLA
  Framework citations: SOC2 CC6.3, ISO27001 A.5.18
  Domain: IAM

[IAM-01.4] Unique identifiers, no shared accounts
  Framework citations: SOC2 CC6.2, ISO27001 A.5.16
  Domain: IAM

REFERENCE RULE — STRICT
You may cite ONLY the control codes listed above, exactly as written.
